abstract: Adobe's 2026 Creators' Toolkit Report (June 16, 2026), based on a Harris Poll survey of 16,000+ creators across 8 countries, finds that 87% of creators using AI say it has accelerated the growth of their business or audience, and 75% describe creative AI as integrated or essential to how they work. The report offers strong counter-displacement evidence: creators are gaining audience, feeling more secure about their future, and out-competing larger teams by using AI.
keyFindings: 87% of creators using creative AI say it has accelerated the growth of their business or audience
75% describe creative AI as integrated or essential to how they work
93% say creative AI helps produce content faster
58% feel stronger competing against larger teams/studios since using creative AI
48% feel more secure about their future as creators
40% report AI-assisted content performs consistently better
85% believe their AI-created work reflects their unique voice
Sample: 16,000+ creators surveyed across US, UK, France, Germany, South Korea, Japan, India, Australia; conducted with The Harris Poll
methodology: Global online survey of 16,000+ creators fielded by Adobe with The Harris Poll across 8 countries in 2026. 'Creator' definition includes independent, freelance, hobbyist, and semi-professional creative workers. Data self-reported.
qualifiers: Adobe is a Tier 2 corporate data source with obvious commercial interest — the survey is designed to demonstrate positive AI outcomes for creators using tools Adobe sells. Selection bias possible: creators willing to respond to Adobe may skew toward those succeeding with AI. Metrics focus on the augmentation/success side, not on displaced or exiting creators. The 87% growth signal is strong but should be balanced against platform-decline evidence.
